result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java` so they match the files they were meant for. The new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (`mvn -o`, 4 + 6 tests, no failures). I did not commit.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group is now `(htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET assembly docs:** the path pattern is `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the path pattern is `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript build scripts:** the pattern is `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It runs the real default conventions against sample paths and content. It checks that `.htm` pkgdown/Doxygen/meta pages, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` with the generator comment, and `build-gradle.js` are caught. It also checks that a hand-written `.htm`, an ordinary `settings.xml`, a hand-written `app.js`, and `app.js` in the build scope are not.

I left the `.html` pattern (the `.xhtml` fix is separate) and the meta-generator regex itself unchanged. Its `"generator" ` pattern requires a trailing space after the closing quote, which may also be too strict for some generators, but that was not part of this task.
